items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: And the left went down and played with Sadie. Yeah. With Sadie and Dave Oxley.

ctx.x: After, after old man, Piku quit. Yeah. And the left went down and played with Sadie. Yeah. With Sadie and Dave Oxley. That was a much easier job and I think he was paying more money than us. Mm-hmm.
Well, I'm really surprised that I had the three saxophones. I always thought those people were real cheap and random. Taxi dance-offs. How many pieces did they usually have?
